purpose: Original continent painting using current project geometry and terrain guides
prompt: Edit the FIRST attached image into an ORIGINAL hand-painted fantasy atlas illustration. The SECOND attached image is a spatially registered terrain/habitat guide of the SAME geography. Output landscape1536x1024 opaque RGB PNG, EXACTLY the same framing, orientation and proportions as these two images. Preserve every coastline, the northern bay, the deep southern gulf, the isolated frozen island north, the southwest island, all eight lake positions/shapes and existing river routes. Keep land and water boundaries at the same image locations. Do not move/resize/rotate landmasses. Do not add islands, inland seas, rivers, land bridges or lakes. Remove all existing grid lines, text, labels, colored region borders, site circles and hatched marks from the FIRST guide; DO NOT print any new words, numbers, symbols, labels, banners or city icons. Sea deep muted blue with restrained watercolor wave texture, land ochre/olive/forest-green washes and fine natural stippling. Flat-map framing with miniature shaded terrain strokes, no tilted/isometric projection, no clouds hiding the land, no ornamental border that crops the scene, no dragon drawing, no towering cities. Early post-Kijin snapshot; this is enduring geography, not later political expansion. The official anime-map tradition informs broad visual character, but copy no official artwork or map composition: follow ONLY the provided original geometry.
